title: Finalize content-driven Style control cadence
description: Make Elementor Style controls appear only when the current widget filter composition includes the corresponding filter type or feature.
objective: Close the remaining editor UX gap by ensuring Content controls drive Style sections consistently, even after switching tabs or importing presets.
expected_outputs: Editor-side filter type flags recalculate from widget settings in any panel tab
Range Style section appears only when a range filter exists
Rating Style section appears only when a rating filter exists
Mechanical verification plus Guilherme editor QA boundary
acceptance_criteria: Removing a filter type from Content eventually removes its type-specific Style section.
Adding a filter type in Content eventually exposes its matching Style section.
The cadence works when the user switches to Style without the Content repeater being visible.
Rating-only widgets do not show a Range-labeled Style section.
verification: PHP lint passes for changed PHP files.
JS syntax check passes for assets/js/eit-editor.js.
git diff --check passes in root and plugin.
Static checks confirm the Content-to-Style sync no longer depends on the filters control DOM.

budgets.context_budget: ContentControls, StyleControls, editor JS cadence helpers
budgets.research_budget: local Elementor docs/source plus prior widget-first planning docs
budgets.validation_budget: lint, syntax, composer, static contract checks

risks: Elementor editor UI refresh behavior can still require Guilherme visual QA because it depends on panel interactions.
Hidden helper settings are editor cadence state and should not become preset-owned data.
